Friday Ladies Ride (Montclair Bikery)

Montclair, NJ · Road

Friday Ladies Ride (Montclair Bikery) is a road group ride in Montclair, NJ. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Montclair Bikery.

Next ride Fri, Oct 9, 9:00 AM EDT
Host's website↗ Add to calendar→ Google Calendar Text it · WhatsApp · Email

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed on the host's own page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Montclair Bikery's public ride calendar (last updated Sept 26, 2026) lists the Ladies Ride every Friday at 9:00 am from 148 Valley Rd, next on Fri Oct 2, and keeps listing it weekly through at least June 2027 (read Oct 1, 2026).

Last seen happening Sep 26, 2026.

For visitors

Arrive 10 minutes before 9:00. The shop's calendar says to have experience riding at least 20 miles, clip-in pedals, hydration and nutrition. Helmets required; wet roads or freezing temperatures cancel. The group-rides page says April through October, but the calendar lists the ride all year, so call the shop in winter. Call the shop for the WhatsApp link.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Ladies Ride (Montclair Bikery) group ride

A weekday-morning women's road ride from the shop, strictly C pace: 20 to 35 miles in the low to mid teens. Shop staff ride along. Call the shop for the WhatsApp link. Helmets required; wet roads cancel.
